import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXN = (1 << 20) + 5;

    static int n, fullMask, total;
    static int[] dp1 = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] dp2 = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] flag = new int[10][10];
    static int[][] grid = new int[10][10];
    static int[][][] tripleIdx = new int[10][10][10];

    static long modExp(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long modInv(long x) {
        return modExp(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static boolean satisfies(int a, int b, int c) {
        int[] nums = {a, b, c};
        int[] order = {0, 1, 2};
        do {
            if (flag[nums[order[0]]][1] == 1 && 
                flag[nums[order[1]]][2] == 1 && 
                flag[nums[order[2]]][3] == 1) {
                return true;
            }
        } while (nextPermutation(order));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] array) {
        int i = array.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && array[i] >= array[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = array.length - 1;
        while (array[j] <= array[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        int temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
        reverse(array, i + 1, array.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] array, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            int temp = array[start];
            array[start] = array[end];
            array[end] = temp;
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }

    static void traverse1(int coef, int row, int col) {
        if (row == 7 && col == 1) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i)
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j)
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k)
                        if (satisfies(i, j, k)) {
                            int x = 1;
                            while (x == i || x == j || x == k) ++x;
                            int y = x + 1;
                            while (y == i || y == j || y == k) ++y;
                            int z = y + 1;
                            while (z == i || z == j || z == k) ++z;
                            state |= tripleIdx[x][y][z];
                        }
            dp1[state] = (dp1[state] + coef) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        
        flag[row][col] = 1;
        if (col == 3) traverse1((int)((long)coef * grid[row][col] % MOD), row + 1, 1);
        else traverse1((int)((long)coef * grid[row][col] % MOD), row, col + 1);
        flag[row][col] = 0;
        
        if (col == 3) traverse1((int)((long)coef * (MOD + 1 - grid[row][col]) % MOD), row + 1, 1);
        else traverse1((int)((long)coef * (MOD + 1 - grid[row][col]) % MOD), row, col + 1);
    }

    static void traverse2(int coef, int row, int col) {
        if (row == 7 && col == 4) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i)
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j)
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k)
                        if (satisfies(i, j, k)) state |= tripleIdx[i][j][k];
            dp2[state] = (dp2[state] + coef) % MOD;
            total = (total + (int)((long)dp1[fullMask ^ state] * coef % MOD)) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        
        flag[row][col - 3] = 1;
        if (col == 6) traverse2((int)((long)coef * grid[row][col] % MOD), row + 1, 4);
        else traverse2((int)((long)coef * grid[row][col] % MOD), row, col + 1);
        flag[row][col - 3] = 0;
        
        if (col == 6) traverse2((int)((long)coef * (MOD + 1 - grid[row][col]) % MOD), row + 1, 4);
        else traverse2((int)((long)coef * (MOD + 1 - grid[row][col]) % MOD), row, col + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String[] line = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                int temp = Integer.parseInt(line[j-1]);
                grid[i][j] = (int)((long)temp * modInv(100) % MOD);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; ++i) grid[i][i] = 1;
        
        int idx = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i)
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j)
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k)
                    tripleIdx[i][j][k] = 1 << idx++;
        
        traverse1(1, 1, 1);
        fullMask = (1 << 20) - 1;
        
        for (int bit = 0; bit < 20; ++bit)
            for (int state = 0; state <= fullMask; ++state)
                if ((state >> bit & 1) == 1)
                    dp1[state] = (dp1[state] + dp1[state ^ (1 << bit)]) % MOD;
        
        traverse2(1, 1, 4);
        total = (MOD + 1 - total) % MOD;
        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
